description: Erection of a bungalow with landscaping and boundary treatment following demolition of existing garage at the rear of No. 7.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1066.21.1, 18/3225/2, 18/3225/9 A, Location Plan, Reasonable Exception Statement and U-value Calculation. Received on 25/11/2022; 18/3225/8 C and 18/3225/3 D. Received on 03/02/2023; Energy Statement for Planning 2023 and GLA Carbon Reporting Spreadsheet. Received on 01/03/2023; 18/3225/3 E, Drainage Assessment Form and Flood Map. Received on 02/03/2023; Surface Water Strategy. Received on 14/07/2023) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The development shall not be implemented other than in accordance with the materials approved under 00673/7/P5(3-7).

Condition : 4 - Secure covered cycle parking facilities (for not less than 2 bicycles) for occupant of the development shall be installed in the cycle shelter. The approved facilities shall conform to the current Westtrans West London Cycle Parking Guidance (or such other guidance as shall supersede it) in design and layout and be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development or commencement of the approved use as appropriate and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
Condition : 5 - The hereby approved development shall only be used as living accommodation by one permanent occupant at any one time.

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the hereby approved development or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 7 - The bathroom window formed in the rear elevation as shown on drawing numbers 18/3225/8 C and 18/32225/9 A of the hereby approved development shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 8 - a)	No development shall take place above ground until the applicant has entered into a binding arrangement with the Council to make an agreed contribution to the Council's Carbon Offset Fund, in accordance with the zero carbon strategy set out in the Energy Statement for Planning 2023 and GLA Carbon Reporting Spreadsheet hereby approved to an amount that equates to the shortfall in required energy savings to meet the 'zero carbon' target.

b)	Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy and any subsequent approved revisions.
Condition : 9 - Prior to first occupation of the building hereby approved, the development shall have been constructed to achieve an internal water use of 105 litres/person/day or less.

Condition : 10 - The development hereby approved shall not be implemented other than in strict accordance with the sustainable materials details approved under 00673/7/P5(3-7) of which:
"	At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.
"	At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.
"	No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.

Condition : 11 - The development hereby approved shall not be occupied until, the boundary treatment and division of the plot as shown on the drawings numbered 1066.21.1 and 18/3225/3 D have been erected and this boundary shall be retained permanently thereafter.

Condition : 12 - The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until the hard and soft landscaping details approved under 00673/7/P5(3-7) have been implemented in their entirety and shall be maintained as such at all times thereafter.

Any trees or plants that, within 5 years of planting, die, are cut down, uprooted, destroyed or become (in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority) seriously damaged or defective, shall be replaced with another tree or plant of the same size and species within the first planting season following its death, removal, uprooting or destruction, unless the Local Planning Authority gives its prior written approval to any variation.

Condition : 13 - The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until the existing vehicular access on Browell's Lane is permanently closed with kerbs and footway reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement, including removal of any footway crossover.

Condition : 14 - The approved refuse and recycling store as shown on the approved drawings numbered 18/3225/8 C and 18/3225/3 D shall be completed and made available for use before the building hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, and thereafter shall be retained for such use at all times without obstruction. Bins shall be stored within the store at all times and shall not be left on the public highway.

Condition : 15 - Notwithstanding the details on the approved plans, prior to commencement of groundworks (excluding site investigations and demolition), the applicant must submit final detailed drainage design drawings, including updated infiltration testing, supporting calculations and an updated Drainage Assessment Form to the Lead Local Flood Authority for review and approval. A detailed management plan confirming routine maintenance tasks for all drainage components must also be submitted to demonstrate how the drainage system is to be maintained for the lifetime of the development. The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the approved details.

Condition : 16 - No part of the development hereby permitted shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and installation contracts) is submitted to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme for the site has been completed in accordance with the submitted details. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.
